# `aitbc governance profile power`

Set a profile's own voting power (admin; fixes profiles stuck at 0).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance profile power [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile-id` | text | — | yes | Profile ID to update |
| `--voting-power` | float | — | yes | New own voting power (>= 0; admin only) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance profile power --profile-id <profile_id> --voting-power <voting_power>
```
